task: Prioritize Edit Mode entry delay and grouping failures
behaviors: Entering Edit Mode does not wait for a duplicate full assignment download; server lease acquisition and snapshot verification remain mandatory.
Grouping SOA09143-S5 and SOA09140-S5 uses complete item details despite unrelated background order refresh events.
A selected order becoming incomplete during hydration is revalidated before grouping.
Changed selection, plan, or local draft during hydration cannot be silently overwritten or grouped.
Grouping existing split orders without changing their quantities preserves PO allocations and does not request a new split.
Real split quantity changes with active allocations remain rejected and failed saves roll back.
Existing Oct-20 route repairs, order quantities, historical evidence, and concurrent edits are preserved.
